title: 🔥 GODLY MARRIAGE VS. WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS—WHICH ONE DO YOU HAVE? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GODLY MARRIAGE VS. WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS—WHICH ONE DO YOU HAVE? 🔥
📖 Ephesians 5:25 – "Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her."

🚨 IT'S VALENTINE’S DAY—BUT LET ME ASK YOU A SERIOUS QUESTION:
💡 Is your relationship built on God, or just emotions?
💔 Are you in a godly marriage, or are you trapped in a worldly relationship?
The world has twisted love into something temporary, selfish, and full of compromise. But God designed love and marriage to be sacred, selfless, and eternal!
🔥 TODAY, YOU WILL DISCOVER THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN GODLY LOVE & WORLDLY LOVE!

🔥 1. THE FOUNDATION OF TRUE LOVE—WHAT IS IT BUILT ON?
📖 Matthew 7:24-27 – "A wise man builds his house on the rock… but a foolish man builds his house on the sand."

✔️ GODLY MARRIAGE is built on CHRIST—the rock that never fails.
❌ WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS are built on EMOTIONS, MONEY, or LUST—things that fade!
🚨 IF YOUR RELATIONSHIP IS NOT BUILT ON GOD, IT WILL NOT LAST!
💡 QUESTION: Is your relationship growing in Christ, or just surviving on emotions?

🔥 2. WORLDLY LOVE IS SELFISH—GODLY LOVE IS SACRIFICIAL!
📖 1 Corinthians 13:4-7 – "Love is patient, love is kind… it does not seek its own."
🔥 HERE’S THE DIFFERENCE:
❌ WORLDLY LOVE:

Loves only when it feels good.
Wants to take, not give.
Full of lust, lies, and broken promises.
Ends when problems come.
✔️ GODLY LOVE:

Commits even when it’s hard.
Loves through sacrifice and selflessness.
Is faithful, pure, and built on trust.
Endures all seasons.
🚨 IF YOUR RELATIONSHIP IS BASED ON LUST, IT WILL FAIL!
💡 QUESTION: Is your love self-centered or Christ-centered?

🔥 3. GODLY MARRIAGE HONORS GOD—WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS HONOR THE FLESH!
📖 2 Corinthians 6:14 – "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers."
❌ WORLDLY RELATIONSHIPS:

Compromise God’s standards for love.
Put pleasure over purity.
Ignore God’s commandments for marriage.
✔️ GODLY MARRIAGE:

Honors purity and holiness.
Follows biblical roles of husband and wife.
Puts Christ at the center.
🚨 MANY ARE TRAPPED IN RELATIONSHIPS GOD NEVER APPROVED!
💡 QUESTION: Does your relationship glorify God—or lead you away from Him?

🔥 4. GODLY LOVE LASTS FOREVER—WORLDLY LOVE FADES!
📖 Mark 10:9 – "What God has joined together, let no man separate."
❌ WORLDLY LOVE:

Based on feelings, attraction, and emotions.
Easily destroyed by temptations and trials.
Leads to heartbreak and broken families.
✔️ GODLY LOVE:

Rooted in God’s unchanging Word.
Strengthened through prayer and faith.
A reflection of Christ’s love for the Church.
🚨 WORLDLY LOVE BREAKS—BUT GODLY LOVE ENDURES!
💡 QUESTION: Are you chasing temporary love or eternal love?

🔥 5. HOW TO BUILD A GODLY MARRIAGE & LOVE THAT LASTS!
📖 Ecclesiastes 4:12 – "A cord of three strands is not quickly broken."
🔥 HERE’S HOW TO KEEP GOD FIRST IN YOUR RELATIONSHIP:

✔️ PRAY TOGETHER DAILY – Strengthen your bond in Christ.
✔️ STUDY GOD’S WORD TOGETHER – Build a marriage that lasts.
✔️ FORGIVE QUICKLY – Don’t let the devil create division.
✔️ SERVE GOD AS A COUPLE – Love grows when it’s rooted in faith.
✔️ PUT CHRIST ABOVE YOUR FEELINGS – Love is a commitment, not just emotions!
🚨 IF JESUS IS NOT THE CENTER, THE RELATIONSHIP WILL CRUMBLE!
💡 QUESTION: Will you commit to putting God first in your relationship?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: IF GOD IS NOT IN YOUR LOVE LIFE, YOU’RE HEADED FOR DISASTER!
📖 Proverbs 16:3 – "Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and He will establish your plans."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Temporary love that fades?
❌ Relationships built on lust and emotions?
✔️ A marriage that honors God and lasts forever?
🚨 DON’T SETTLE FOR LESS THAN GOD’S BEST!
💡 WILL YOU SURRENDER YOUR LOVE LIFE TO JESUS TODAY?

🙏 PRAYER FOR A GODLY RELATIONSHIP!
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my love life to You. I refuse to settle for a relationship that dishonors You. Teach me to wait on Your best and build a love that glorifies You. Protect my heart from worldly love and help me to seek You first in all things. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
